cases.name: call-protection
cases.description: The native boundary validates inputs, protects allocated objects, and returns through R-aware error paths.
cases.prompt: Review a .Call routine that allocates an intermediate vector, reads a numeric input, and can fail on empty input. Identify the safety requirements before shipping it.
traps: Reads element zero before checking length
Uses exit() or lets a C++ exception escape

assertions.text: Checks SEXPTYPE, length, dimensions, and empty-input behavior before access.
Protects newly allocated intermediates and balances UNPROTECT calls.
Uses R-aware error signaling rather than process termination.

cases.name: rcpp-package-boundary
cases.description: The package workflow distinguishes Rcpp export generation, dependency declarations, and correctness testing.
cases.prompt: Add a small Rcpp function to a package. Explain the source layout, DESCRIPTION entries, generated wrappers, and tests needed for missing values and indexing.
traps: Assumes C++ bool preserves R's NA

assertions.text: Places native source under src/ and declares Rcpp through the package dependency workflow.
Uses Rcpp::compileAttributes() or the established generator rather than hand-editing generated files.
Tests one-based versus zero-based indexing and R missing-value semantics.
